name: tabs
gotchas: Each `mat-tab`'s content is instantiated the first time that tab becomes active and stays in the DOM (just hidden) afterward — don't assume components inside a tab you've already visited get re-created when you switch back to it.
Binding `[(selectedIndex)]` and listening to `(selectedTabChange)` on the same `mat-tab-group` both fire — guard against feedback loops if the change handler also reassigns `selectedIndex`.
Dynamically adding/removing `mat-tab`s shifts the indices of the remaining tabs — a stored `selectedIndex` from before the change can silently point at a different tab afterward.
